sources.entry: Gitea - Git with a cup of tea! Painless self-hosted all-in-one software development service, including Git hosting, code review, team collaboration, package registry and CI/CD. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Go/Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: Gitea is a self-hosted, all-in-one software development service covering Git hosting, code review, issue tracking, wiki, package registry and CI/CD, written in Go.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Gitea as a self-hosted all-in-one development service that bundles Git hosting, code management, code review, issue tracking, project kanban, wiki, team collaboration, package registry and CI/CD. The CI/CD component is described as able to reuse GitHub Actions. Because it is written in Go, the README says it runs on all platforms and architectures Go supports, including Linux, macOS, FreeBSD/OpenBSD and Windows on x86, amd64, ARM, RISC-V 64 and PowerPC. Configuration is split between dynamic options in the admin panel and static options in an app.ini file. The README also points to an official Go SDK, a CLI tool called tea, and an action runner for Gitea Actions.
use_cases: running CI/CD with GitHub Actions-compatible workflows
hosting a personal or organization code forge
how_to_run: Build from source: see docs/build-source.md and docs/build-setup.md for prerequisites
Deploy with the official container image (docker/podman), per the README's mention of the official image
Edit app.ini for static configuration and restart the instance
notable: Single Go binary runs on many OSes and architectures, including RISC-V 64 and PowerPC
Bundles Git hosting, code review, kanban, wiki, package registry and CI/CD in one service
Official go-sdk, tea CLI and Gitea Actions runner
Config can be changed at runtime from the admin panel or statically via app.ini
caveats: Self-hosting requires you to run and maintain the server yourself
Building from source needs the prerequisites listed in docs/build-setup.md
Security vulnerabilities are to be reported privately to security@gitea.io
